title: eeev104
subject: EVS
summary: Green School Aasha and Mohit were walking to school together. “Do you like going to school?” Aasha asked. Mohit smiled happily and said, “I love school! It is where I see my friends, play games and learn new things every day. Our school is a place where we feel safe, and cared for. Asha said, “My school teaches us how to care for plants, trees and animals. I want to make my school better like a green school”. “My brother told me once, green school is a school where we manage our waste, save water, use electricity carefully, and make the campus green by planting more trees and taking care of them”. Aasha and Mohit share their idea with their classmates. Their teacher Anupam, who is teaching them ʻThe World Around Usʼ asked, “I enjoyed your discussion, I want to know how will you begin this?”.
